# pbs_time (Data Source)

Reads the current time of a Proxmox Backup Server node and its time zone, which `pbs_timezone` sets. Comparing `time` with `plantimestamp()` shows whether the node's clock is off. Anyone signed in may read it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_time" "this" {}

# Warn when the node's clock is more than a minute off: certificates, tickets
# and job schedules depend on it.
check "pbs_clock" {
  assert {
    condition = (
      timecmp(data.pbs_time.this.time, timeadd(plantimestamp(), "-1m")) >= 0 &&
      timecmp(data.pbs_time.this.time, timeadd(plantimestamp(), "1m")) <= 0
    )
    error_message = "The PBS clock says ${data.pbs_time.this.time}, Terraform ${plantimestamp()}."
  }
}

output "pbs_local_time" {
  value = "${data.pbs_time.this.local_time} (${data.pbs_time.this.timezone})"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Node to read: `localhost` or the node's host name. Defaults to the provider's `node`.

### Read-Only

- `local_time` (String) The same time in the node's time zone, in RFC 3339 format with the zone's current offset from UTC, such as `2026-11-02T11:00:00+01:00`.
- `time` (String) Current time of the node, in RFC 3339 format (UTC), to the second.
- `timezone` (String) Time zone of the node, such as `Europe/Vienna` or `Etc/UTC`.
- `utc_offset` (Number) Current offset of the node's time zone from UTC, in seconds: `3600` for one hour east.
